objective: Implement Milestone 1 (M1) of Self-Hosted Agentic Sandbox Orchestration: Pool Manager, in-pod exec agent, Open SWE adapter (samsung_infra.py), state store with CAS/TTLs, and comprehensive integration tests
acceptance_criteria: Pool Manager HTTP service implements POST /v1/sandboxes (idempotent acquire with reconnect/warm/cold), GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}, POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/exec, and DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{id}
State store handles /threads/{thread_id} compare-and-swap, /sandboxes/{id} state transitions, and /leases/idle/{id} TTL tracking
Lightweight in-pod exec agent executes commands with timeout and captures stdout, stderr, exit code
Open SWE adapter agent/integrations/samsung_infra.py implements BaseSandbox with execute() and derived ls, read, write, edit, glob, grep, registered in SANDBOX_FACTORIES
Integration tests verify idempotent acquire, concurrent racing creates, command execution, derived file operations, idle timeout lease refresh, and teardown
non_goals: Production bare-metal Kubernetes deployment with Kata hardware virtualization (deferred to M4)
Full eBPF Falco daemonset and Cilium network policies (deferred to M3)
Harbor registry preloading automation (deferred to M2/M4)
